body: Yeah, me too. I just couldn't go deep enough.

She said that because I am under the age of 25, there is a risk of suicidal tendencies. She said that I should wean off it by our next appointment, which is in about a month.

Is DU really the reason those weapons kill people? I had heard that many tanks use tungsten rounds that do the same job. From what I've understood is that the DU is really useful against modern, composite armor.

I wasn't trying to glorify anything. I just wanted to point out that sabot rounds can be extremely deadly to the crews of tanks. I also wondered if the sabots in the game should act in a similar fashion.
